The '''Din system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Din]] that went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], creating the [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar]] and devastating the system. The supernova vaporized the inner planets of the system and left only the cores of three [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]], with one that turned out to be a diamond the size of a terrestrial planet. The pulsar's magnetic pulses complicated [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspatial]] travel along the nearby [[Trindello-Endor Route]] and made the Din system inaccessible.<ref name="gamer9" />
